root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The file the condition is about (a package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml), relative to its root; `.` for the analysis root itself

code.description: `WORKSPACE_MEMBER_NO_ROWS`: a member's package.json has no rows this run, so its name, version and dependencies are unknown; `WORKSPACE_MEMBER_EXCLUDED`: a member's package.json is routed away from the data instance (an exclude), so its name, version and dependencies are unknown; `WORKSPACE_TARGET_UNKNOWN`: a dependency that may link a member VAT cannot name links nothing: it matches no member with rows while some member's name is unknown, or it is a plain range under pnpm while link-workspace-packages is unknown (WORKSPACE_SETTING_UNKNOWN); `WORKSPACE_CATALOG_UNRESOLVED`: a `catalog:` range names no entry of the catalogs the manager in effect reads (pnpm-workspace.yaml for pnpm, the root package.json for bun; none for npm or yarn); `WORKSPACE_CATALOG_CONFLICT`: both `catalog` and `catalogs.default` are set (at the file), or a `catalog:` dependency names an entry the manager refuses for that (at the member: every default entry under pnpm, a name in both under bun); such a dependency links nothing; `WORKSPACE_DUPLICATE_NAME`: two members carry one name under npm, yarn or bun; the root, then the first by code-unit path order, keeps it for linking (pnpm keys by name and version: see WORKSPACE_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS); `WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED`: a `workspace:` range under npm or yarn 1, or a `catalog:` range under pnpm before 9.5, which fail the install; it links nothing; `WORKSPACE_PACKAGES_MALFORMED`: the member pattern list is not an array of strings, or pnpm refuses the file for a missing `packages`; VAT reads what it can and says so; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_REFUSED`: this root's workspace rows are refused (the message leads with the refusal code) while other roots answer; the root has no package or dependency rows; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_MAY_BE_ABOVE`: the analysis root declares no workspace, holds a package.json and sits below its repository's top level, so a workspace above it may hold its packages; path is `.`; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_OUTSIDE_ROOT`: a package.json under an analysis root that declares no workspace declares a `workspace:` dependency, so its workspace root may lie above the analysis root; at that package.json; `WORKSPACE_NOT_DECLARED`: pnpm is the manager, the root holds no pnpm-workspace.yaml, and a package.json under it declares a `workspace:` dependency; at that package.json; `WORKSPACE_MANAGER_INFERRED`: the root names no packageManager (or yarn without a version), and VAT read the manager from which files exist at the root, never their content; the message names them; path is `.`; `WORKSPACE_MANAGER_UNKNOWN`: the root names no packageManager and no lockfile, or several managers' lockfiles, exist (path `.`), or a `workspace:` or `catalog:` dependency whose meaning depends on that manager (at the member), which links nothing; `WORKSPACE_MANAGER_VERSION_UNCHECKED`: the pnpm version is unknown or past the newest major whose rules VAT checked; the newest rules are read; path is `.`; `WORKSPACE_SETTING_IGNORED`: pnpm-workspace.yaml sets link-workspace-packages where pnpm never reads it (kebab case, or any setting before pnpm 10.5); `WORKSPACE_SETTING_UNKNOWN`: the root .npmrc, where pnpm may set link-workspace-packages, is not read this run; a plain range that would link a member links nothing, with WORKSPACE_TARGET_UNKNOWN; `WORKSPACE_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS`: under pnpm, several members of the dependency's name satisfy its range; it links nothing; `WORKSPACE_TARGET_UNSATISFIED`: under pnpm, a `workspace:` dependency no member satisfies (pnpm fails the install), or a plain range whose same-named members none satisfies (pnpm uses the registry); it links nothing

seq.description: 0-based position among the path's conditions of this code

projection-workspace-conditions.description: A row of the derived `workspace_conditions` relation
